name: Riffarchy
author: Joson Mathew
description: Practice player for musicians: slow songs down without changing pitch, transpose, loop exact phrases, and pull audio straight from YouTube. Installs the Riffarchy app and adds a bar button that opens it and shows what's playing.

barWidget.description: Opens Riffarchy and shows the current song's speed and loop. Middle click plays/pauses; right click runs setup.

schema.label: Show
schema.description: Show the playing song's speed and loop next to the icon.
